title: sprite-forge pipeline profile
description: Ordered stages executed by scripts/run_pipeline.py. Each stage names a sprite-forge script (or a shell command) and its arguments; ${var} placeholders are resolved from `vars`. Stage input/output hashes are recorded so reruns skip unchanged stages.

vars.description: String substitutions available as ${key} in every string of the profile. `${profile_dir}` and `${skill_dir}` are always defined.

palette.description: Path to an indexed PNG whose palette every output must keep, or null.

provider.description: Default endpoints; stages may override with their own args.

output_root.description: Where run/<timestamp>/manifest.json is written. Keep it inside the project, never /tmp.

stage.description: A script in sprite-forge/scripts without .py (gen_image, retro_diffusion, turnaround, video_to_spritesheet, align_frames, pixel_scale, stitch_spritesheet, split_spritesheet, chroma_key), an absolute/relative path to a Python script, or `shell`.

args.description: key -> value becomes --key value; snake_case keys become kebab-case flags; true becomes a bare flag; lists repeat the flag.

python.description: Interpreter for script stages (default python3). Use `blender` for Blender headless scripts; args then follow `--`.

inputs.description: Files/dirs hashed to decide whether the stage can be skipped.

outputs.description: Files/dirs that must exist after the stage; hashed into the run manifest.

paid.description: Stage spends provider credits; run_pipeline appends --yes only when invoked with --yes.

optional.description: Failure does not abort the run.
